summary: The state is sealed to 3 readers. Attributes, outputs and stored plans are encrypted. Addresses, types, names, dependencies and revisions stay readable, so the graph and the plans keep working.

file.text: No readers file was found in .pravo/access. Writers take the list of readers from the repository, so a sealed state cannot be written from this checkout.

suggestions.title: Add a reader
suggestions.why: The new reader makes an identity and sends the line it prints. A current reader adds the line, commits it and rewraps.
suggestions.who: the new reader, then a current reader

suggestions.title: Set a recovery key
suggestions.why: A recovery key is split into shares, any K of which rebuild it, so that the state can be opened when every reader has lost their key. Give each share to a different person, offline. Whoever holds K shares can read the state, so K is a decision about whom to trust together.

steps.text: Make the key and the shares. This writes recovery-shares/ and .pravo/access/recovery.txt:
Do not commit recovery-shares/. Give each file to a different person, offline.

suggestions.title: Check the state
suggestions.why: The check hashes every record against its name and prints who can read the state.
